note: Asymmetric bounds chosen because the sweep showed tau extrapolation risk collapses much faster than moneyness as bounds tighten. Tighter tau bound (0.15,0.85) keeps risk low while looser moneyness bound (0.10,0.90) preserves more moneyness-tail coverage at comparatively low added risk. Options beyond these bounds (very long-dated, or moneyness beyond ~[0.89,1.32]) are excluded from the grid entirely. Downstream deployment should still compute and pass along per-day extrapolation-fraction as a reliability signal alongside the compressed features.
